title: XDA - Newsletter Writer / Editor
description:
This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis.
About the Role
If you have a knack for catchy headlines, love picking out the coolest daily tech stories, and can hook a reader faster than a viral tweet, this is the gig for you!
XDA is looking for a Freelance Newsletter Writer to turn our daily computing, mobile, and hardware coverage into must-read email newsletters. If you know what makes tech enthusiasts click and want a quick, high-volume daily workflow, we want to hear from you.

• Use our internal CMS article-picker tool to select top published XDA stories across PC hardware, Windows, and computing news.

• Build and pre-schedule weekend newsletter sends ahead of time to maintain an uninterrupted 7-day publishing schedule.

• Craft subject lines and preview text structured to increase open rates, clicks, and reader time-on-site.

Qualifications & Requirements:

• Ability to work quickly in digital tools and maintain a consistent daily publishing workflow.

• Talent for writing snappy intros, engaging email hooks, and click-worthy (non-clickbait) subject lines.

• Strong pulse on XDA’s core coverage (Laptops, PC Hardware, Windows, Android, Peripherals) to choose the most compelling stories for our audience.

• Ability to learn and navigate internal publishing systems and CMS tools.

How to Apply:
Please submit the following materials in your application:

• Your CV / Resume

• A brief Cover Letter detailing your experience with email newsletters, digital marketing, or short-form copywriting

•
2-3 writing samples demonstrating your copywriting style (short-form summaries, email copy, or catchy tech write-ups)

The hiring team at XDA will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you’d make a solid addition to the team. Only applications containing relevant writing samples will be considered.

title: Applied Research Scientist, World Model
description:
About the team
Zillow has the richest housing market data in the industry. You help us build out a foundational model that leverages a representation of who is in the market, what they’ll pay, and how that demand clears against supply.

The Agentic Foundations team is a focused group of 15-20 applied scientists within Zillow’s broader Agentic AI organization, building the foundational AI technologies that power the next generation of home shopping experiences. This Principal Applied Scientist will help build the Zillow World Model: a single, uncertainty-aware model of the housing market that ties together supply, demand and macro conditions such as mortgage rates and policy. Today, bespoke models like Zestimate, Time-to-Pending and Listing Soon each answer one question well. The foundational “World” Model aims to answer the multi-step “what if” questions consumers actually ask, such as “If I list at $500K, when will it sell?” or “I want at least $800K; what should I list at?”, as consistent projections of one market state, and to serve those answers to Voyager, Zillow’s AI Mode, as a tool.

This is a very new field and an open-ended research effort. You will partner with the World Model working group (listing-state modeling, market simulation and evaluation) and with product, engineering, platform and data teams. Zillow observes both sides of the housing market at a depth no one else can, so this work can directly help guide users toward their goals. About the role

• Build the demand layer of the World Model: turn large-scale shopper behavior (search, engagement, session trajectories) into structured demand representations, including explicit attention-to-demand conversion.

• Design and train latent state-space, multi-tower and/or sequential dynamics models with calibrated uncertainty that support multi-step rollouts, forward planning (“if I do X, what happens?”) and backward planning (“I want X; what should I do?”).

• Estimate willingness-to-pay, per-home demand curves and market clearing dynamics, connecting learned representations to economic quantities.

• Apply causal identification in observational data and define where the model must abstain because a correlation does not support a “what-if” claim.

• Contribute to the World Model evaluation battery: state probes, calibrated multi-target forecasts, rollout drift, causal checks and out-of-regime replays.

• Independently drive ambiguous research end-to-end, and provide technical leadership and mentorship in translating state-of-the-art research into production impact.

title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker-Remote
description:
It is Adjuvant's vision to be the nation’s leading oncological behavioral health provider. Our mission is to inspire hope through advancing mental wellness to cancer patients, their families and caregivers. We are looking for empathetic, experienced mental health professionals to come along side us in this endeavor!
This is a fully remote role.
Pay: $60-62/hr
Through a respectful, constructive and energetic style, guided by the mission of the clinic, a therapist will seek to facilitate hope and change in the lives of their clients who have been affected by cancer. A therapist is responsible for accepting referrals and maintaining a client load (minimum 18 hours per week).
This role begins as a 1099 contractor position. After 90 days and averaging 25 hours a week, you will have the option to transition into a W2 role.
Primary Responsibilities:

• Counsel clients or patients individually and/or within family sessions, to assist in overcoming dependencies, adjusting to life, or making changes.

• Make internal referrals to IOP if little to no improvement occurs within 8 weeks of OP therapy.

• Guide clients in the development of skills or strategies for dealing with their problems.

• Develop and implement treatment plans based on clinical experience and knowledge, establishing SMART goals with the patient. Treatment plans are to be developed 72 hours after intake and updated / modified every 4 weeks.

• Fill out and maintain client-related paperwork, including client diagnostic records and progress notes. Progress notes are to be developed 48 hours after every session.

• Prepare and maintain all required treatment records and reports.

• Evaluate clients' physical or mental condition, based on review of client information.

• Collaborate with other staff members to perform clinical assessments or develop treatment plans within 2 days of establishing care with the existing patient.

• Refer patients, clients, or family members to community resources or to specialists as necessary.

• Learn about new developments in counseling by reading professional literature, attending courses and seminars, or establishing and maintaining contact with other social service agencies.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Masters Degree from an accredited college or university

• Two years of professional level experience in a counselor setting

• Current and active license to practice behavioral health in Texas

Preferred Qualifications:

• 2+ years experience in healthcare with oncology

• 1 year experience in Telehealth Settings

Salary: $60-62/hour Originally posted on Himalayas
